claims.text: Open-source LLMs achieved up to 40% higher accuracy for explicitly mentioned SDoH compared to a baseline pattern-matching model.
openchat_3.5 surpassed the baseline pattern-matching model in overall accuracy across all nine evaluated SDoH aspects.
Prompt engineering in the refined LLM extraction pipeline reduced hallucinations.
Prompt engineering in the refined LLM extraction pipeline improved extraction accuracy.
Two human reviewers achieved 93% inter-annotator agreement on manual SDoH labels.

methodologies.name: Zero-shot open-source LLM extraction with prompt engineering
methodologies.description: Evaluation of eight open-source LLMs without fine-tuning against a baseline pattern-matching model to extract nine SDoH aspects from clinical EHR notes.

limitations.text: Information recorded as free-text notes in EHRs is difficult to reliably extract at scale, limiting utility in research.

future_work.text: Further refinement and domain-specific training of open-source LLMs to enhance utility in clinical research and predictive analytics.
